title: Vertical null-homotopy of the residual Cartan--Eilenberg defect
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $K^\bullet$ and $L^\bullet$ be cochain complexes, and let $I^{p,q}$ and $J^{p,q}$ be first-quadrant double complexes with augmentations $\epsilon_I:K^\bullet\to I^{\bullet,0}$ and $\epsilon_J:L^\bullet\to J^{\bullet,0}$. Assume the augmented boundary, cycle, and horizontal-cohomology rows of $I$ are exact resolutions, with exact sequences $0\to Z_I^p\to I^{p,\bullet}\to B_I^{p+1}\to0$, and the corresponding augmented rows of $J$ are injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $R:I\to J$ be a morphism of double complexes that vanishes on the augmentation $K^\bullet\to I^{\bullet,0}$. Then the comparison theorem applied to the boundary, cycle, and horizontal-cohomology rows gives null-homotopies of the induced row maps; assembling these through the displayed exact sequences yields maps $s_2^{p,q}:I^{p,q}\to J^{p,q-1}$, with $s_2^{p,0}=0$, such that $R=d_vs_2+s_2d_v$ and $s_2$ commutes with the horizontal differentials.

proof.text: Because $R$ is a morphism of double complexes and is zero on the augmentation, its restrictions to the augmented boundary, cycle, and horizontal-cohomology rows are maps of augmented complexes whose composite with the source augmentation is zero. The exact sequences $0\to B_I^p\to Z_I^p\to H_I^p\to0$ and $0\to Z_I^p\to I^{p,\bullet}\to B_I^{p+1}\to0$, together with commutation of $R$ with the horizontal differential, make the induced maps compatible with the subobject and quotient maps.

proof.text: Apply the exact-source/injective-target comparison theorem to the induced maps on the boundary, cycle, and horizontal-cohomology rows. The theorem is the special case of the acyclic-to-bounded-below-injective null-homotopy result obtained by adjoining the augmentation object in degree $-1$; it gives row homotopies $h_B$, $h_Z$, and $h_H$, all zero in degree zero, satisfying $R_B=d_vh_B+h_Bd_v$, $R_Z=d_vh_Z+h_Zd_v$, and $R_H=d_vh_H+h_Hd_v$.

proof.text: Construct $s_2$ and homotopies $h_B^p$ of $R_B^p$ and $h_Z^p$ of $R_Z^p$, zero in vertical degree zero, by induction on $p$, keeping the invariant that $h_Z^p$ restricts to $h_B^p$ on $B_I^p$; start with $h_B^0=0$ since $B_I^0=0$ in the first quadrant. Given $h_B^p$, apply the compatible-homotopy assembly lemma to $0\to B_I^p\to Z_I^p\to H_I^p\to0$ (augmented by $0\to B^p(K)\to Z^p(K)\to H^p(K)\to0$) with target $0\to B_J^p\to Z_J^p\to H_J^p\to0$ and $s_Z=h_B^p$; it yields $h_Z^p$ with $h_Z^p\iota=\iota_Jh_B^p$, and the augmentation condition is $R\epsilon_I=0$. Apply the same lemma to $0\to Z_I^p\to I^{p,\bullet}\to B_I^{p+1}\to0$ (augmented by $0\to Z^p(K)\to K^p\to B^{p+1}(K)\to0$, the column being exact as an extension of exact rows) with target $0\to Z_J^p\to J^{p,\bullet}\to B_J^{p+1}\to0$ (degreewise split, so $J^{p,\bullet}$ is injective) and $s_Z=h_Z^p$; it yields $s_2^{p,\bullet}$ with $s_2^{p,0}=0$, $R=d_vs_2+s_2d_v$ on $I^{p,\bullet}$, $s_2i=jh_Z^p$, and a homotopy $h_B^{p+1}$ of $R_B^{p+1}$ with $\rho s_2^p=h_B^{p+1}\pi$. Since $d_h=i\iota\pi$ on both $I$ and $J$, one gets $s_2^{p+1}d_h=s_2^{p+1}i\iota\pi=jh_Z^{p+1}\iota\pi=j\iota_Jh_B^{p+1}\pi=j\iota_J\rho s_2^p=d_hs_2^p$, using the invariant at $p+1$; this completes the induction.

lean.statement: theorem cartanEilenberg_vertical_nullhomotopy (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] (K L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (I J : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) (eI : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K ⟶ I) (eJ : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L ⟶ J) (hI : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (I.X p)) (hJ : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (J.X p)) (hsource : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap eI p) ∧ QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' (eI.f (p - 1)) (eI.f p) (eI.comm (p - 1) p))) ∧ QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eI p)) (htarget : ∀ p : ℤ, QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap eJ p) ∧ QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' (eJ.f (p - 1)) (eJ.f p) (eJ.comm (p - 1) p))) ∧ QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eJ p)) (hinjective : ∀ (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ), Injective ((J.cycles p).X q) ∧ Injective ((image (J.d (p - 1) p)).X q) ∧ Injective ((J.homology p).X q)) (R : I ⟶ J) (hR : eI ≫ R = 0) : (∀ p : ℤ, Nonempty (Homotopy (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap R p) 0) ∧ Nonempty (Homotopy (image.map (Arrow.homMk' (R.f (p - 1)) (R.f p) (R.comm (p - 1) p))) 0) ∧ Nonempty (Homotopy (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap R p) 0)) ∧ ∃ s : ∀ p : ℤ, Homotopy (R.f p) 0, (∀ (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ), (s p).hom 0 q = 0) ∧ (∀ (p p' : ℤ) (q q' : ℕ), (s p).hom q q' ≫ (J.d p p').f q' = (I.d p p').f q ≫ (s p').hom q q')
lean.note: Uses the bicomplex and induced augmentation convention of exists_cartanEilenberg_resolution. Source exact augmented rows are quasi-isomorphisms; target injective resolutions use the defining fields of InjectiveResolution. Homotopy supplies the vertical equation and the zero component at degree zero; horizontal compatibility is explicit. Canonical cycle-column-boundary sequences are automatically short exact in the abelian category of vertical complexes.
